task.notes: t = 1/3 between the brackets (test: E7.75 at t = 1/2 between E7.5 and E8.0).

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

copy.what: real reference cells at the count rule

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_depth.what: fgw with each bracket's cells binomially thinned to the interpolated stage's predicted depth (log-linear between the brackets' median counts per cell; a shallower bracket kept as released)
fgw_depth.rule: depth: the interpolated stage's median counts per cell = exp((1 - t) log d_before + t log d_after), d = a bracket's median counts per cell over all its cells; cells of a bracket deeper than that are binomially thinned by target / d (panel genes and the rest of the library alike), a shallower bracket's cells are left as they are

fgw_blend.what: fgw's cells as binomial blends of each cell and a coupled partner of the other bracket, splitting the expected counts (1 - t) : t at the predicted depth
fgw_blend.rule: blend: depth: the interpolated stage's median counts per cell = exp((1 - t) log d_before + t log d_after), d = a bracket's median counts per cell over all its cells; cells of a bracket deeper than that are binomially thinned by target / d (panel genes and the rest of the library alike), a shallower bracket's cells are left as they are
